title: Find and install an app
blurb: Add an app from the marketplace and connect it to your account.

steps.title: Open App Marketplace
steps.body: Click **App Marketplace** in the left menu.

steps.title: Find the app
steps.body: Search for the app by name, or browse the categories.

steps.title: Read about it
steps.body: Click the app. Check what it does, the price and the reviews.

steps.title: Install it
steps.tip: Can't find or install an app? Some need us to add them for you. Ask us to switch this on: hello@luubu.com

steps.title: Check permissions
steps.body: Read the list of what the app can see and do, like your contacts or conversations, then approve.

steps.title: Finish setup
steps.body: Follow the app's own setup steps. Some ask you to log in to the other service.
